Stocks that turned 1 lakh into 1 crore in 10 years: only 2 made it

We checked every stock in today's Nifty 500 and Nifty Microcap 250 for a 100x rise between 20 Nov 2016 and 20 Nov 2026. Only 2 stocks turned ₹1 lakh into more than ₹1 crore.

Cupid: 148.8x, ₹1 lakh became ₹1.49 cr.
Tips Music: 138.9x, ₹1 lakh became ₹1.39 cr.

The hard part was holding. Tips Music fell about 40.5% in 2025, from ₹811.65 to ₹483, before recovering to ₹774.40 by 11 Nov 2026. Cupid rose over 565% in 2025 alone, the kind of jump that tempts most people to sell early.

Compounding rewards time: at about 64.9% a year, money doubles roughly every 1.4 years, so most of the wealth arrives in the final years.

Price change only, split and bonus adjusted, dividends not included. Companies that were delisted or left these indices are not covered. Past returns are history, not a guide to the future.

script: 1. Stocks that turned 1 lakh into 1 crore in ten years. Only two stocks did it. Can you guess them?
2. We checked every stock in today's Nifty 500 and Microcap 250 over ten years. Turning one lakh into one crore needs a hundred times rise.
3. Number one, Cupid. One lakh became one point four nine crore, about a hundred and forty nine times. Number two, Tips Music. One lakh became one point three nine crore.
4. Cupid makes condoms and personal-care products. Its quarterly revenue doubled in a year, and the stock rose over five hundred and sixty five percent in 2025 alone.
5. Tips Music is one of India's leading music labels. It earns a return on equity of about eighty five percent.
6. Here is the hard part. In 2025, Tips Music fell about forty percent. Selling near the low meant missing the recovery. And after a rally like Cupid's, selling feels like the obvious move.
7. That is compounding. At about sixty five percent a year, money doubles every one point four years, and over sixty percent of the final amount comes in the last two years.
